_readme: Issue-linked known-failure baseline for the corpus round-trip invariant gate
(#293, corpus-roundtrip.test.ts). See that file's docblock for the ratchet,
and corpus-gate.test-utils.ts for the loader that validates this shape.
It is JSON, not a TypeScript literal, so `scripts/check-known-failures.mjs`
can read it without a TS toolchain — an exemption whose issue has been closed
must be catchable by CI, and CI cannot import a .ts test file.
Every entry carries the issue that OWNS the failure. `status` says what the
open     — a live bug; the issue must still be OPEN. A closed issue means
the fix landed and this line is orphaned baseline: CI fails.
accepted — a recorded by-design decision (the issue is normally closed).
`accepted` is for a tradeoff someone WROTE DOWN, never for
`note` is required and explains the failure in its own words; the surrounding
prose that used to live in comments belongs here, next to the entry it is about.
